breakdown.description: It places the overall composition at 10 wt% B, which lies outside the stated α+β tie-line interval of 25–70 wt% B, but still claims the alloy is in the α+β region.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses C_0 = 40 wt% B as the overall alloy composition, which lies within the tie-line interval of 25–70 wt% B. This fixes the original error where C_0 = 10 wt% B was placed outside the α+β region. The lever rule calculations (67% alpha, 33% beta) are consistent with C_0 = 40 wt% B: W_β = (40-25)/(70-25) = 15/45 ≈ 33%, W_α = (70-40)/(70-25) = 30/45 ≈ 67%.
